## Round evidence

This report reads saved results only. It does not call a model or change reviews.
Pass rate covers reviewed cases; routing accuracy covers cases with a recorded decision.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import pandas as pd

root = Path.cwd()
if not (root / "acme").is_dir():
    root = root.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
from acme.lab import load_lab

workbook = root / "data/Acme_Fibre_Grounded_Draft_Eval.xlsx"
reviews_path = root / "runs/reviews.json"
lab = load_lab(workbook)
raw = reviews_path.read_bytes() if reviews_path.exists() else b"{}"
records = {r["case_id"]: r for r in json.loads(raw).values()
           if int(r["round"]) == int(review_round)}
rows = []
for case in lab.cases:
    rec = records.get(case["id"], {})
    rows.append({"case": case["id"], "intent": case["expected_intent"],
                 "expected_human": case["needs_human"],
                 "decision": rec.get("decision"), "verdict": rec.get("verdict")})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
reviewed = df[df.verdict.isin(["Pass", "Fail"])]
routed = df[df.decision.isin(["send", "escalate"])]
missed = routed[routed.expected_human & routed.decision.eq("send")]
print(f"Round: {review_round}; dataset: {len(df)} cases")
print(f"Reviewed: {len(reviewed)}; routed: {len(routed)}; missed escalations: {len(missed)}")
print("Pass rate: " + (f"{reviewed.verdict.eq('Pass').mean():.1%}" if len(reviewed) else "N/A"))
print("Routing accuracy: " + (f"{routed.decision.eq('escalate').eq(routed.expected_human).mean():.1%}" if len(routed) else "N/A"))
print("Workbook SHA256: " + hashlib.sha256(workbook.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("Reviews SHA256: " + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
```

## Missed escalations

```{python}
print(missed[["case", "intent", "decision"]].to_string(index=False) if len(missed) else "None among recorded decisions.")
```

case-specific explanations before sharing. A clean routing result is not proof of factual correctness.
